title: Network Services Company - completed acquisition of certain distribution agreements from NDD Distribution Pty Ltd

timeline.event: ACCC commenced review under the Merger Review Process Guidelines.
Closing date for submissions from interested parties.
ACCC announced it would not oppose the proposed acquisition.

body_sections.Summary: On 1 August 2010 Network Services Company acquired a number of assets and client contracts of NDD Distribution Pty Ltd.
body_sections.Market definition: The ACCC considered the completed acquisition in the context of the national market for magazine distribution services.
body_sections.Competition analysis: The ACCC concluded that the completed acquisition was unlikely to substantially lessen competition in the relevant markets. In forming this view, the ACCC had regard to a number of factors including: - the competitive constraint posed by existing market participants, including Gordon & Gotch and Fairfax, along with smaller magazine distributors; and - the threat of new entry by logistics service providers, which have pre-existing distribution routes, capital and infrastructure suitable for use in magazine distribution.
